about.description:
My training at 42 in Bangkok gave me solid technical foundations, real discipline and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. My systems administration background also lets me handle deployment and infrastructure (Docker, Nginx, Vercel). Two years spent in Cambodia taught me to adapt quickly and collaborate in diverse environments.

Alongside client work, I build my own products, like Whoa UI, a React component library, or Whoa Stash, a macOS app: useful tools, built to last.
